description: Runs Voice Mode's realtime sessions through a Vercel AI Gateway key, so voice bills to one gateway account and the bb host never needs an OpenAI key. Voice Mode asks installed connection plugins for a session; this one mints a single-use client secret from the gateway and returns its realtime URL with the secret already attached to the WebSocket handshake. Pick the model (gpt-realtime-mini by default), set an optional team scope, and run bb realtime-gateway test to confirm the handshake before relying on it. Needs a Vercel AI Gateway key with usage billing; no OpenAI key on this host.
